description: The Compendium of Anaerobic Digestion Microbiomes Database (CAnDi) brings together curated microbial, viral, and plasmid data from anaerobic digestion ecosystems. It is a dedicated platform for exploring anaerobic digestion ecosystem data, including metagenomes, metagenome-assembled genomes (MAGs), viral taxonomic units (vOTUs), and plasmid taxonomic units (PTUs).
name: CAnDi
